import json
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path = Path('results/expansion/bolt_resume_plan.json')
record = {'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'one conditional missing-only Bolt resume after a fresh catalogue check'},'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
          'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'waiting_for_dated_catalogue',
          'prior_failure':'results/expansion/bolt_partial_failure.json'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
catalogue = Path('results/expansion/models_20261030.json')
while not catalogue.exists():
    time.sleep(5)
data = json.loads(catalogue.read_text())
record['catalogue_sha256'] = file_sha256(catalogue)
ids = {m['id'] for m in data.get('data',{}).get('data',[])}
if data.get('status') != 'completed' or 'nvidia/nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b' not in ids:
    record['status'] = 'skipped_unlisted_or_failed_catalogue'
else:
    command = ['bash','scripts/with_resource.sh','nim','.venv/bin/python','-u','scripts/expand_nim.py',
               '--models','nvidia/nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b','--protocol-file','protocol-bolt-resume.json']
    record.update(status='acquiring_global_slot_then_resuming',command=command)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    result = subprocess.run(command)
    record.update(status='finished',exit_code=result.returncode)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
